notes.title: Patch! Jarl Axe nerf, the inflatable hammer is back and Battle Pass fixes!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927733/c953042f178c9f5b2688172b9b2017a10cbfeea0.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello everyone! Thank you for your patience.[/b]

We are aware that there are more bugs than the ones solved in this patch, especially concerning desync issues and we thank you all for reporting them. Unfortunately, they are products of the game's networking code and would require an entire rework of the game. For now, such a big undertaking is unlikely to happen. 

We have also seen the requests to add the Brawl mode that was worked on in the early betas and announced by us as a F2P feature. We hoped that the F2P launch would bring in enough players to support another mode, as it has not done so, we have decided not to go forward with it. We are sorry to say that there are no current plans to add Brawl to TABG unless something significant changes. 

We want to be as transparent as possible about what to expect going forward and will keep you posted about TABG's future. We are sorry that we haven't been able to set expectations correctly in the past, we will do better. 


[h3]PATCH NOTES:[/h3][strike][/strike]

[list]
[*] Nerfed Jarl Axe damage with 30%, now takes 2 hits to kill a standard health player.
[*] Inflatable hammer readded into the item spawn pool.
[*] Fixed issue where some items were missing for players who bought the Battle Pass.
[*] Fixed a bug where changing the keybinding for playing the catchphrase didn't actually change it.
[*] Some Anti-cheat fixes.
[/list]

As per usual remember to restart steam and verify the integrity of the game files.

notes.title: New TABG Update! Battle Pass, Area 64 and more
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927733/1e23cec860dda95365907e39f0ebb7d3755b9e50.jpg[/img]

[h3]The new update is out! Today’s update includes some well-awaited features like the results screen, reporting system, and balance! We're also adding a Battle Pass and some nice map changes.  [/h3]

[h2]Battle Pass[/h2]
We’re trying out a Battle Pass due to popular demand.

The Battle Pass comes with free and premium rewards. You level up the Battle Pass by playing and unlocking rewards along the way. 

In total there are 60 levels to keep you occupied for a while! We’re adding some new cool cosmetics, MC rewards, and a bunch of new [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@landfallgames/video/6989841333192068357?is_copy_url=0&is_from_webapp=v1&sender_device=pc&sender_web_id=6943232363762304518]G-mode music[/url]!

[b]The premium tier is 6$, if you want to participate without premium items it’s free. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927733/78cf46fad0e9d51a907bdb102234a42859a4d6de.png[/img]

[h2]Area 64[/h2]
Area 64 has been completely reworked and is looking better than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927733/bacf804569631bf01967bca57b00b4de9ce273d4.png[/img]

[h2]Result screen and leaderboards[/h2]
We have added a result screen after each match as well as leaderboards, you can now see how you compare to other players and who you’ve killed and who killed you. 
Changes to the leveling system
We have changed the way leveling works by adjusting the XP curve to be fairer for high-level players. 

We're also removing the MC gain from leveling since the Battle Pass free tier now gets you MC from just playing the game. 

[h2]A reporting system[/h2]
This update also adds a reporting system. You can report players in the pre-game from the escape menu OR through the new result screen. We hope this will catch cheaters that manage to get through the anti-cheat. 

[h2]Patch Notes: [/h2]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
Added a battle pass.
[list]
[*] Reworked AREA 64.
[*] Added a new game results screen.
[*] Added the ability to report players in the pre-game & game result screen.
[*] Added in-game leaderboards.
[*] Added the ability to equip different G mode music.
[*] Added the ability to equip different throwable chat message models.
[*] Added cloud sync for equipped items. They will now auto-sync between PCs.
[*] Added the ability to see player names in the lobby of players close to you.
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the XP Curve for player levels. It should be significantly fairer towards high-level players.
[*] Adjusted the catchphrase UI.
[*] Removed damage difference on limbs for Melee weapons. Making a hit to the head deal the same damage as a hit to the foot.
[*] Increased the size of the accuracy barrel
[*] Decreased the number of knockback Weapons and arms take
[*] Reduced the damage reduction when Dual wielding

[*] Removed the Tactical Maneuver blessing

MC can be bought in-game using Steam wallet money OR be earned by leveling up! 

You gain 25 MC per level (and we're giving everyone MC for past levels, so if you have played before this update you'll most likely have some MC to spend already).

The store will feature new items every week and there is also a daily store that will display 10 random items. 

This patch also introduces a new menu for equipping clothes and coloring them to easily be able to view and search your items.

[h3]This update should also fix the bug where some users lost their founders' pack items.[/h3]

[*] Added blessing of airstrike
[*] Added blessing of tactical maneuver.
[*] Updated take damage effect.

notes.title: Server changes!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

We just released a small patch removing all servers except two. 

[u]We do this for two reasons:[/u]

1 ) We want as many players in one match as possible, this means instead of new players accidentally ending up in empty servers they will end up in the same. We hope this will lead to less confusion and fuller matches.

2) The second server will be used for modding with the EQU8 anti-cheat turned off. We know the community has wanted this for a while. You play on this server at your own risk and will most likely encounter cheaters with mods! 

[b]We know a lot of you are waiting on the F2P update, we’re currently still working full time on TABS and don’t know when we will have the time to go F2P with TABG. Thank you for sticking with us![/b]

Make sure to restart steam and verify the integrity of the game files. 

We cannot answer comments on this post so if you have any questions please post them in the steam forums or email info@landfall.se

notes.title: News on the F2P update, new cosmetics and the helmet of shame!
notes.notes:
In November we posted a list of what we’re working on, you can find it here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/823130/announcements/detail/1700567065814770192
Our hope was to release the big update early this year but as it stands now we are not ready and we need our three programmers on Totally Accurate Battle Simulator.

For those who don’t know, TABG is a spoof of our main game Totally Accurate Battle Simulator. TABG was originally only meant to be an April Fools joke so that the Totally Accurate Battle Simulator players had something to do while they waited for release. We don’t want to keep them waiting any longer and to release Totally Accurate Battle Simulator we need all hands on deck. 

What does this mean? It means that we will not go F2P as soon as we hoped but we will further down the road. We’re not abandoning the game, we still want to bring in more players and finish the new brawl mode. We’re also looking into ways of getting help from other studios on the project but as it stands now we don’t know when the F2P update will be.

We never expected this game to have such an amazing dedicated player base, we want to do you justice but for that, we need some more time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927733/b262e8a51d306766b0b271a26ee46b4c65519ef8.jpg[/img]

As a consolation we’ve added some new cosmetics to play around with, we devs also promise to wear the new shame-helmet every time we play!

notes.title: Patch 8.2: Some performance and ring changes
notes.notes:
We know cheating is currently a huge issue. Unfortunately this is not the patch that fixes that but we are very close to having a first line of defense that will be going live before the end of the week. 


This patch aims to fix the issues a lot of players have been experiencing with the ring. 
We’re adding more time to the end game and increasing the amount of bikes and motorcycles in non-main areas. This should give players a bigger chance against the ring even if you don't jump a high action area. Thank you all for the feedback on patch 8! 
Please let us know what you think of the new ring speed.

New regions:
-US_West
-US_East
-AU

(South American servers have been ordered and are on the way)

Changes:
-Made the first ring (Not the one that is already moving when you start, the one after that) start quite a bit later. 
-Added a bunch of bike and motorcycle spawns to smaller compounds
-Fixed a bunch of audio bugs ("shoot! shoot!")
-Lowered volume of Tripoloski
-Added the names of the two new areas to the map interface
-Fixed issue where the Two Shot would bug out if you put scopes on it. 
-Hopefully fixes issue that was causing blurry visuals after the first wall is placed
-Limited amount of parrots that can be thrown per second
-Made it impossible for hackers to spawn parrots on other players.

Performance:
-Optimized inactive cars
-Dead players are now removed after 10 seconds


Please keep questions to the forums or email info@landfall.se as we cannot answer here.

Make sure to restart steam and verify the integrity of the game files, the server may take a few minutes to update.

notes.title: Patch 8: The really good patch (Hopefully)
notes.notes:
We are currently migrating servers and therefore EU1,US1 and AS1 will take a bit longer to update. 
If they dont work, please try EU2, US2 or AS2 instead. 
These might however be somewhat unstable because of the increased load while the main servers are down.  

Features:
-Added vehicle: Bike
-Added vehicle: Motorcycle
-Added vehicle: Motorcycle with sidecars
-Added weapon: Rainmaker
-Added weapon: Two Shot
-Added weapon: Inflatable hammer
-Added weapon: Fish
-Added weapon: Smoke rocket launcher
-Added weapon: Taser minigun
-Added weapon: Sniper shotgun
-Added weapon: Winchester shotgun
-Added: III
-Added a tall castle
-Added an outpost near mountain town

Fixes:
-Shields now actually protect you from bullet. Both on your back and in you hand
-Bullets now make a metal sound when hitting shields
-Fixed issue where downed players would not get downed on some clients
-Fixed issue where a teammate sometimes would not be revivable 
-Grenades no longer show the message "You downed yourself"
-The final ring will no longer trap you while closing (Probably)
-Made players skydiving super smooth
-Added extrapolation that should help smooth out lagging players
-You will now be thrown off if you attempt to stand on the wall. (Inwards)
-Fixed issue where winchester was one handed
-Fixed invisible walls next to industry
-Most likely fixed dying when entering cars (again)

Changes:
-Double barrel shotgun has been made one handed
-Double barrel shotgun now fires 8 pellets instead of 10
-Single fire Crossbow arrow speed increased
-The first ring is now visible as soon as you start flying on the trucks
-The ring speeds have been tweaked to make the game a bit faster and promote more action.
-The final ring is now a mix between the moving walls and the lava arena. 
-Helicopter has been given more mobility.
-Removed a collider that usually made the helicopters tail get stuck
-Doubled cage time of cage grenade
-Reduced knocked down time when landing 
-Slightly increased saturation
-Changed color of musket ammo to further distinguish it from shotgun ammo
-Increased the amount of loot in low tier houses


Performance: 
-Removed lots of small objects that were heavily impacting performance without adding to the gameplay. 
-Testing out GPU instancing for world objects
-Optimized the player character 

Shoutout to Joel
